subject: Probe kit provisioning & conditional access pact
messages:
From: Priya Oberoi <priya@acmeretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Probe kit + legal/usage constraints

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the lower tail latency looks promising for our in-store recommender tests. Procurement asked me to get a short, written plan for the evaluation assets we discussed: the probe kit (promptpacks + testcases) and a small sample of our anonymized transaction logs.

Two items procurement specifically wants in writing:
- A mutual action plan that spells out delivery milestones and the close timeline.
- Usage constraints: how long Redwood will hold the data, whether samples can be cached, and redistribution limits.

Can you send a one-page MAP + any manifest for the probe kit we intend to provision? Ideally we start the sandbox on Feb 1 and wrap the evaluation by Mar 15.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Product Manager — Data & Insights
Acme Retail

[Attachment: acme_request_summary.txt (text, 3 KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Oberoi <priya@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Probe kit + legal/usage constraints

Priya —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a draft MAP and probe-kit manifest for Acme that reflects the timeline you proposed. Highlights up front:

- Delivery: Redwood will stage a restricted probe kit (prompt packs + 500 anonymized transaction rows) into a sandbox on 2027-02-01.
- Access: Ephemeral access tokens, role-based access for two Acme engineers and one data steward.
- Retention and caching: Redwood will retain the sample and any generated traces for up to 60 days post-close; prefix/KV caches used for throughput will be cleared on takedown. No persistent copies will be kept beyond 60 days unless otherwise negotiated.
- Redistribution: No redistribution outside Acme + Redwood evaluation team; derivations for internal benchmarking are allowed but cannot be shared externally.
- Escrow / destruction: At close (target 2027-03-15) Redwood will either delete assets or place them into a short-term escrow (30 days) if Acme requests a formal handoff window.

Next steps I'd like to propose:
1) You confirm the two Acme users who need sandbox access and the procurement contact for DocuSign.
2) Redwood sends a sealed MAP (attached) plus a short CSV manifest listing the testcases.
3) Procurement signs the MAP and the test/data transfer addendum; we start provisioning on Feb 1.

I copied Marissa for operational support and Karthik for any contractual/top-level exceptions. Naomi is on the security checklist and will follow up on the SOC/Security evidence needed.

Attachments: acme_probekit_mpa_v1.pdf, acme_testcases_manifest.csv

—
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
(415) 555-0149

Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Probe kit + legal/usage constraints

Forwarding Jonas' draft MAP to the operational team — a few implementation notes from my side so we can size the work:

- Sandbox ops: We'll provision a single dedicated sandbox in us-west with 2 vCPU-equivalent workers and a 16 GB KV cache allocation for testing. Estimated cost: small credit draw; I'll include in the MAP.
- Data ingress: We'll accept SFTP or secure Drive transfer; prefer encrypted archive. Naomi, can we confirm the acceptable encryption ciphers for incoming artifacts?
- Testcases: I reviewed the CSV manifest; we should mark edge-case test IDs with the label EDGE- and flag any PII-suspect rows for redaction before ingestion.

Action items for ops: Karthik, please include the takedown automation runbook and the exact deletion API calls in the final MAP appendix.

-Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
